Title: Redirection support for the mysqlnd PHP driver connecting to MariaDB now in preview

Body.Content: Redirection support for the mysqlnd PHP driver used to connect to Azure Database for MariaDB is now available in preview. Take advantage of the mysqlnd_azure extension to improve the connection latency between applications and the managed database services. For more information, see our service documentation.
